claims.gist: Sonatype cataloged over 877,000 known malicious packages last year
Packages pushed to open-source repositories now exceed 100,000 a day
Security teams prioritize vulnerabilities and ignore malware-driven risk blind spots
CVE scanning misses active exploits and image scanning misses compromised build pipelines
Teams should audit GitHub Actions, Terraform modules, IDE extensions and ML models
Immediate actions: pin dependencies, require cooldowns, disable install scripts
Installing the Claude Code plugin and running /audit-supply-chain fixes immediate issues

thesis: Open-source malware needs controls beyond CVE scanning: pinned dependencies, cooldowns, script limits, and a checklist plugin.
